translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
aasmano aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai , woh Allah ki tasbeeh kerti hai , aur badshahi ussi ki hai , aur tareef ussi ki , aur woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
wohi hai jiss ney tumhen peda kiya , phir tum mein say koi kafir hai , aur koi momin . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay khoob dekhta hai .
uss ney aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq peda kiya hai , aur tumhari soorten banai hain , aur tumhari soorten achi banai hain , aur ussi ki taraf aakhir kaar ( sabb ko ) palat ker jana hai .

aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , woh ussay janta hai , aur jo kuch tum chup ker kertay ho aur jo kuch khullam khula kertay ho , uss ka bhi ussay poora ilm hai , aur Allah dilon ki baaton tak ka khoob janney wala hai .
kiya tumharay paas unn logon  kay waqiyaat nahi phonchay jinhon ney pehlay kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , phir apney kamon ka wabal chakha , aur ( aaenda ) unn kay hissay mein aik dardnak azab hai-?

yeh sabb kuch iss liye huwa kay unn kay paas unn kay payghumber roshan dalaeel ley ker aatay thay to woh kehtay thay kay :  kiya ( hum jaisay ) insan hain jo hamen hidayat den gay-? gharz unhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur mun morra , aur Allah ney bhi bey niazi barti , aur Allah bilkul bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !

jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh yeh dawa kertay hain kay unhen kabhi dobara zinda nahi kiya jaye ga . keh do :  kiyon nahi-? meray perwerdigar ki qasam ! tumhen zaroor dobara zinda kiya jaye ga , phir tumhen bataya jaye ga kay tum ney kiya kuch kiya tha , aur yeh Allah kay liye mamooli si baat hai .
lehaza Allah per aur uss kay Rasool per aur uss roshni per emaan lao jo hum ney nazil ki hai , aur tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

. ( yeh doosri zindagi ) uss din ( hogi ) jab Allah tumhen roz-e-hashar mein ikattha keray ga . woh aisa din hoga jiss mein kuch log doosron ko hasrat mein daal den gay ,   aur jo shaks Allah per emaan laya hoga , aur uss ney naik amal kiye hon gay , Allah uss kay gunahon ko moaaf kerday ga , aur uss ko aesay baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . yeh hai bari kamiyabi .
aur jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hoga , aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hoga , woh dozakh walay hon gay jiss mein woh hamesha rahen gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .
koi museebat Allah kay hukum kay baghair nahi aati , aur jo koi Allah per emaan lata hai , woh uss kay dil ko hidayat bakhshta hai ,   aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .
aur tum Allah ki farmanbardaari kero , aur Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . phir agar tum ney mun morra to humaray Rasool ki zimma daari sirf yeh hai kay woh saaf saaf baat phoncha dey .
Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi hai , aur mominon ko Allah hi per bharosa kerna chahiye .

aey emaan walo ! tumhari biwiyon aur tumhari aulad mein say kuch tumharay dushman hain , iss liye unn say hoshiyar raho . aur agar tum moaaf kerdo , aur darguzar kero , aur bakhsh do to Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
tumharay maal aur tumhari aulad to tumharay liye aik aazmaesh hain ,   aur woh Allah hi hai jiss kay paas bara ajar hai .

lehaza jahan tak tum say hosakay Allah say dartay raho ,   aur suno aur maano , aur ( Allah kay hukum kay mutabiq ) kharch kero , yeh tumharay hi liye behtar hai . aur jo log apney dil ki lalach say mehfooz hojayen , wohi falah paaney walay hain .
agar tum Allah ko achi tarah qarz do gay to Allah tumharay liye uss ko kaee guna barha dey ga ,   aur tumharay gunah bakhsh dey ga , aur Allah bara qadardaan , boht burdbaar hai .
woh her bhed ka aur her khuli hoi cheez ka janney wala hai , baray iqtidar ka , bari hikmat ka malik !
